_comment: 1.14.7 Game Rules. Launcher writes choices to data/rules.txt. Backend reads them at startup. All native gameplay checks remain pending.

rules.title: Universal progression rate
rules.blurb: Applies to recognized player, weapon, Hunt Pass and mastery progression grants. Does not change Escalation saves.

rules.title: Weapon XP speed
rules.blurb: Multiplies recognized weapon ExperienceTrack grants. Requires the game server to send those grants.

rules.title: Hunt Pass XP speed
rules.blurb: Multiplies progress grants for Hunt Pass tracks found in the original 1.14.7 season table.

rules.title: Mastery progress speed
rules.blurb: Multiplies mastery-track progress grants; quest and challenge objective counters are unchanged.

rules.title: Material reward amount
rules.blurb: Multiplies catalog-verified material rewards, including Aethersparks and Cell Dust. Costs and purchases keep normal quantities.

rules.title: Rams reward amount
rules.blurb: Multiplies Rams rewards in eligible additive transactions, not shop purchases or refunds.

rules.title: Combat Merit reward amount
rules.blurb: Multiplies Combat Merit rewards. Spending remains normal.

rules.title: Exploration Merit reward amount
rules.blurb: Multiplies Airship/Exploration Merit rewards. Spending remains normal.

rules.title: Rare Core reward amount
rules.blurb: Multiplies Rare Cell Core quantities, including cores added by the per-kill toggle.

rules.title: Rare Core per Behemoth kill
rules.blurb: Adds a Rare Cell Core when an eligible inventory transaction contains a known Behemoth kill token. Does not invent kill events.

rules.title: Free crafting
rules.blurb: Keeps ingredients for exact catalog-matched equipment crafting and upgrade transactions. You still need the recipe unlock and ingredients once. Does not waive shop, fusion or reforge costs.

rules.title: Free platinum
rules.blurb: Platinum prices become 0: store offers, Hunt Pass rank skips and extra loadout slots. Platinum you own is kept. Off when hosting friends. By KombatKing.

rules.title: Extra loadout slots
rules.blurb: Free extra loadout slots on top of the starter slot and the five Slayer's Path slots, no platinum needed. Slots you get are kept, even if you turn this back to Normal. They show the next time you sign in. Playing with friends: you AND the host MUST both have server files with this rule, or your loadouts will not load on the host.

rules.title: When you host
rules.blurb: Host with friends or LAN: Use my rules = your Game Rules on this page apply to everyone in your game, and the players who join you take home what they earn with them. Standard rules = everyone plays with normal rules while you host. Games open to everyone (Allow randoms, Play online) always use the standard rules.
